equipment_type: Air conditioner BACnet gateway (1 indoor unit)
applies_to: Mitsubishi Electric residential, Mr. Slim and City Multi indoor units with a CN105 (CN92 on some) connector.
summary: A one-unit Intesis interface that plugs into the CN105 socket of a Mitsubishi Electric indoor unit and serves it as BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP. It exposes 23 fixed objects for on/off, mode, setpoint, fan, vane, room temperature, error codes, run hours, occupancy logic and remote lock.
notes: The manual prints Hours as the units of the four occupancy setpoint AVs; they are setpoints and are listed here in °C.
There is no RoomTemperature_command object on this model; AI 1 is named 'Room Temperature'.
LockRemoteControl (BV 2) state texts are printed as 0=Locked, 1=Unlocked.
The capacity table says 24 objects; the member table lists 23 plus the Device object.

source.title: Intesis BACnet - Mitsubishi Electric AC User Manual (INBACMIT001I000)

integration.summary: Connect the gateway to the indoor unit (supplied 1.5 m cable into the CN105 socket (CN92 on some units)), set the BACnet network on its DIP switches, then write the _command objects (on/off, mode, setpoint, fan) and read back the matching _status objects. One gateway serves one indoor unit (or one remote-controller group), so give each gateway its own MAC address and device instance.

minimum_points.name: SetPoint_status
minimum_points.why: Setpoint the unit is really using

integration.enable: No enable point or BMS/local switch is documented; the gateway accepts BACnet commands as soon as it is communicating with the unit. A wired remote controller can still be used in parallel; BV 2 LockRemoteControl locks it.
setup: BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP is chosen with a DIP switch (MS/TP is the default); switch changes need a power cycle.
BACnet IP: factory static IP 192.168.100.246; change it (or select DHCP) with the Intesis configuration tool.
MS/TP MAC address 0-127 is set on DIP switches; baud rate is DIP-selectable (9600-115200) with autobaud as the default, which matches the baud rate of another MS/TP device running a fixed rate.

Default device instance 246000. In automatic mode the instance is a base (246000, changeable in the configuration tool) + the SW2 MAC address; it can also be set manually or by writing Object_Identifier.
Do not lengthen or modify the supplied CN105 cable.
gotchas: Every function has a separate _command (AO/BO/MO, commandable) and _status (AI/BI/MI) object; write the command, read the status.
Temperatures follow the Celsius/Fahrenheit DIP switch; the BACnet Units property changes with it.

The Occupancy MV and its four AVs drive built-in logic that sets mode, setpoint and on/off; leave Occupancy at 3 (Disabled) unless you use it, and any manual on/off, mode or setpoint change cancels it.
